meta.description: Lawful academic full-text downloader supporting open-access retrieval, publisher API access (Elsevier, Springer Nature, IEEE), CNKI institutional access for Chinese literature, and institutional browser-based fallback. Requires Node.js 22+ and Python 3. Uses only lawful OA, publisher API, and user-authorized institutional access.

scientific_integrity.detail: Uses only lawful OA sources (PMC, Unpaywall, arXiv, publisher OA pages) and legitimate institutional access. Does not bypass paywalls or DRM. Clear audit trail with manifest tracking.

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for academic literature access. Respects institutional authorization boundaries. Does not export credentials or attempt unauthorized access. User handoff for identity-bearing secrets.

methodological_ground.detail: Access routing logic sound (OA first, then API, then institutional). Publisher API fallback to OA is methodologically correct. Verification-first rule for CAPTCHA bounded and reasonable.

code_usability.detail: Working batch_download.mjs orchestration script. Configuration tools (configure_school.py, configure_credentials.py) provided. Clear preconditions and status categories.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage: OA retrieval, publisher APIs (Elsevier/Springer Nature/IEEE), CNKI for Chinese literature, institutional browser fallback, Supporting Information downloads. Handles DOI, PMID, title, URL inputs. Batch and single-paper modes.

reliability.note: Robust routing logic with fallback chain (API → OA → institutional). Format principle prevents HTML/login-page mis-saves. Verification-first for CAPTCHA bounded. Manifest tracking. Minor: verification-first rule limited to 2 attempts could fail on transient network issues.

performance_context.note: Efficient fast-batch path keeps large DOMs/PDFs outside agent context. Provider-friendly pacing. Token discipline enforced. Minor: no explicit guidance for very large batches (100+ papers) or rate-limit recovery strategies.

agent_usability.note: Clear routing logic with decision tree. Comprehensive status categories (30+). Configuration tools well-documented. SI confirmation gate enforced before download. Minor: complex preconditions (7 items) could benefit from automated health-check script. Browser-state principle excellent but lacks fallback when CDP unavailable.

human_usability.note: Bilingual operation (Chinese/English). Clear configuration wizards. Manifest output with typed failures. User handoff for identity secrets excellent. Minor: institutional URL triage classification could use visual decision tree for non-technical users.

security.note: Excellent security practices: no credential export, browser-state principle respects authentication, API keys stored with 0600 permissions, save-on-receipt pattern prevents key exposure in logs. User handoff for 2FA/OTP. Does not bypass DRM or paywalls.

maintainability.note: Excellent modular architecture: separate modules for school config, credentials, metadata resolution, provider downloads, content validation. Advanced routes in references/ on-demand. Token discipline prevents context pollution. Clear status taxonomy.

agent_specific.note: Strong orchestration design with batch_download.mjs keeping large data in scripts. Token discipline excellent. SI confirmation gate prevents ambiguous runs. Verification-first rule bounds CAPTCHA attempts. Minor: lacks explicit guidance for CDP attach failure recovery beyond asking user to check checkbox.

key_strengths: Excellent security design: browser-state principle, no credential export, API keys stored securely (0600), user handoff for identity secrets
Comprehensive lawful access routing: OA → publisher API → institutional fallback with proper prioritization and automatic fallback logic
Strong token discipline: fast-batch path keeps large data in scripts, surfaces only compact status, prevents context pollution
Robust verification-first rule: bounded CAPTCHA attempts (max 2) before user handoff, maintains authenticated tab state
Clear manifest tracking: route, access mode, OA evidence, format, SHA-256, typed failures provide complete audit trail

recommendations.title: Add automated precondition health-check script
recommendations.problem: Seven preconditions (browser state, school config, login, CDP, Node.js, Python, web-access proxy) must be verified manually. Failures often only discovered during download attempt.
recommendations.root_cause: Preconditions listed in documentation but no single health-check command validates all conditions before batch run.
recommendations.fix: Create scripts/health-check.mjs that verifies: (1) Node.js 22+ available, (2) Python 3 available, (3) school.json exists and valid, (4) CDP proxy reachable, (5) browser remote debugging enabled, (6) test CDP target attach. Exit with specific error codes and remediation suggestions.

recommendations.title: Add verification re-entry guidance after user manual solve
recommendations.problem: When verification-first rule hands off to user after 2 failed CAPTCHA attempts, no explicit guidance for agent to re-enter workflow after user manually solves challenge in kept-open tab.
recommendations.root_cause: User handoff documented but re-entry workflow missing. Agent must infer how to continue from verification_auto_failed status.
recommendations.fix: Add to references/delivery-verification-and-failures.md: 'After user handoff for verification_auto_failed, (1) confirm user has solved challenge, (2) re-check page state from same CDP target, (3) if challenge cleared, retry download from current page, (4) update status to retry_after_user_verification → downloaded. Include example sequence.'

recommendations.title: Add output directory README with manifest schema
recommendations.problem: Batch downloads create organized directory structure (PDFs/, CNKI/, SupportingInformation/, FullText/) with manifest.json but no README explaining organization or manifest schema for users inspecting output.
recommendations.root_cause: Output structure documented in skill but not in generated output directory itself.
recommendations.fix: Generate README.md in output directory with: (1) directory organization explanation, (2) manifest.json schema (status categories, route types, access modes), (3) file naming conventions, (4) SHA-256 verification instructions. Include link to full documentation.
